independent_integrity_check: All24 source hashes and48 resized image hashes verified; every output has exactly equal RGB channels. Script inspected; direct full-square resizing without padding.
decision: Accept all24 whole-image derivatives as prospective training candidates. This preparation preserves collars and original head framing better than the pilot affine crop. It does not establish improved model performance; active110 dataset unchanged.
diversity_limitations: Some pairs show family resemblance, notably149/159 and151/161. Independent generation calls do not prove distinct identities. Poses and clothing remain fairly similar across the set; no novelty score claimed.
data_geometry: Eye positions and facial scale vary; mixing with old eyes42 requires a deliberately recorded new dataset/fork.
